meta.name: dashboard
meta.description: Review the portfolio across existing engagement records. Use for status across customers; requires accessible permitted records and does not create missing client histories.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把各个客户的往来记录汇总成一份状态总览,随时看清整体进展
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有多个客户的合作记录,需要定期汇总看整体状态
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you track multiple client engagements and need a regular roll-up of overall status

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会基于已有的 engagement 记录做组合层面的状态回顾，给出跨客户的状态视图；它使用本地 CLI 和已获授权的脱敏数据包，不会为完成任务而新建或补全缺失的客户记录。缺记录或缺访问权限时，会如实报告为限制。
howto.when: 当你需要查看跨客户的状态、且相关记录可访问并已获授权时，它会先读取任务上下文契约和方法再展开。若由 @fde 调用，则沿用其现有的脱敏数据包与范围，不重跑设置或已答过的问题。

say.text: 用现有 engagement 记录给我一份跨客户状态回顾
say.note: 会先读任务上下文契约与方法再产出

say.text: 客户 X 的记录我这边没有权限，请把这点标为限制
say.note: 缺少记录或访问会如实报告，不新建

say.text: @fde 已有脱敏数据包，直接沿用它的范围做组合回顾
say.note: 复用 @fde 的数据包与范围

howto.what_en: Claude reviews the portfolio across existing engagement records and reports status across customers, using permitted sanitized packets. It does not create missing histories; missing records or access are reported as limitations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need status across customers and the records are accessible and permitted; it reads the task context contract and method first. If called by @fde, it reuses that packet and scope.

say_en.text: Use the existing engagement records to give me a portfolio status review
say_en.note: Reads the task context and method first

say_en.text: No access to client X's records — flag that as a limitation
say_en.note: Reports missing records or access; creates nothing

say_en.text: @fde already has a sanitized packet — reuse its scope for the review
